synopsis:
The novelization of the original film, published months before its 1977 release as *Star Wars: From the Adventures of Luke Skywalker*.

Luke Skywalker, a farm boy on the desert world of Tatooine, is drawn into the Rebellion when two droids carrying the stolen plans to the Empire’s Death Star fall into his hands. With the aging Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi, the smuggler Han Solo, and the rescued Princess Leia Organa, he joins the fight to destroy the battle station before it can crush the Alliance.

Credited to George Lucas and written by Alan Dean Foster, the book keeps scenes and background the finished film left out.
title: A New Hope
